final: WITH dept_counts AS (SELECT ma.department AS dept, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM member m JOIN major ma ON ma.major_id = m.link_to_major GROUP BY ma.department), total AS (SELECT SUM(cnt) AS total_cnt FROM dept_counts), shares AS (SELECT d.dept, d.cnt, CAST(d.cnt AS REAL) / t.total_cnt AS share FROM dept_counts d CROSS JOIN total t WHERE t.total_cnt IS NOT NULL), avg_share AS (SELECT AVG(share) AS avg_s FROM shares) SELECT s.dept, s.cnt, s.share, s.share - a.avg_s AS share_minus_avg FROM shares s CROSS JOIN avg_share a WHERE a.avg_s IS NOT NULL AND s.share > a.avg_s
